newsitem.title: UK: Innovative Tech in 10.7 mln stg U.S deal. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Innovative Tech in 10.7 mln stg U.S deal. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: Innovative Technologies Group Plc said on Monday it would buy the woundcare division of Polymedica Industries Inc of the U.S. for 10.7 million stg, paid for by a placing and open offer to raise about 12.7 million stg before expenses.
(Corrects to show Innovative is buying a division of Polymedica).

Innovative, a leading developer and manufacturer of woundcare products, said the deal would give it two new product ranges based on porous membrane technology, plus manufacturing facilities in Colorado in the US and Tarvin in Cheshire in Britain.
Polymedica had net assets of $2.9 million at March 31 1997, its turnover was $2.6 million and it made a loss of $506,000.
